title: Dow Jones futures tick higher ahead of Fed interest rate decision
summary: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.14% to trade near 52,190 during European hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures rise by 0.21% to trade around 7,600, while Nasdaq 100 futures advance by 0.42% to trade near 29,080.

title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Bounces off two-month low; seems vulnerable near mid-0.5700s
summary: The NZD/USD pair bounces off an over two-month low, around the 0.5735 area touched earlier this Wednesday, though it lacks any follow-through buying.

title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps to near $65 ahead of Fed’s interest rate decision
summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 1.8% to near $64.80 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The white metal trades firmly ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.
